entities.summary: Takafumi Iwasaki (b. 1976-08-29, Kumamoto Prefecture) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kumamoto Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
